done_when: A design part's own redraw may change only the Design line of an approved story's What changes for you without voiding the approval or asking for a new cold read; any other change to What changes for you or Done when still needs a new approval; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade
why: When a story's design part redraws the screens, the plan's Design line changes and Forge treats the approved plan as changed, asking for a new cold read and a new approval although the owner already saw the screens
